name: ex-s1
idea_origin: Exploración line, 29 Oct: replica calibrated on the 2,743 real DeepSeek story decisions (choice model, scripts/exploracion/); quality judge on cp-v12
operator: ex-v1 + run-memory script with a state file per run (C60), called as a third call in every reply
hypothesis: A script that keeps the run record (Best, ceilings shown by quarterly purchases that did not register, Health trend, stalled start, blow-ups) and turns the quarterly lines into menu numbers makes the quarter exact and frees the agent from bookkeeping. Calibrated replica: ceiling detection adds +0.0 (+0.6 only if ceilings were known in advance, which a run cannot know); on the 23 real family games the script marks 1,470 ceilings with no false mark. Expected value about 0; the test is whether a third call keeps the pair of calls.
predicted_behaviour: Three calls in at least 90 % of story replies; quarters follow the printed plan; tokens per month under 0.6 M.
refutation: Pairing (take_action + observe in one reply) below 90 % in probes, or script errors in more than 5 % of calls.
change: ex-v1 + script/brief.py, a Run memory section and a third call in the literal reply block and in the manifest.
notes: Evidence: lab/reports/exploracion/README.md (replica calibrated on the real DeepSeek decisions, quarter search, Sonnet bank, quality judges). The Skill states observations from our runs as ours, with no thresholds, titles or fixed answers; margins on the published 0-10 ranges are marked as ours. Test plan: lab/reports/exploracion/plan-deepseek.md.
